profile.headline: I code stuff @ Adobe
profile.geoLocationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
profile.summary:
Alexa… play my walk out music. 

I build things. I’ve built fintech products, e-commerce sites, business facing CMS, VC calculators, whatever. 

I am an engineering leader who thrives at the intersection of complex technical architecture and team culture. Currently, I manage an engineering squad at JPMorgan Chase, where I focus on scaling mission-critical financial tools and building teams for longevity. 

My background spans from leading full-stack migrations - like moving Traeger to a headless CMS in 14 weeks - to architecting recursive financial modeling engines. I am passionate about developer experience, resilient system design, and fostering a workplace where every setback is treated as a solvable challenge.

Core Stack: Rails, Next.js, React, PostgreSQL, SpiceDB, AWS (ECS/EKS), Docker.

positions.title: Manager of Software Engineering
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States · On-site
positions.description:
My previous company (Aumni) was acquired by JPMorgan. During my time as manager, I was in charge of a couple of squads: Portfolio/Scenarios/DevOps 

Primary Initiative Delivery: Executing the "Workspace" (Customer Input Data) project, a top-tier company priority. Architected a Kotlin/Springboot microservice layering organization-specific PostgreSQL data over legacy calculations while utilizing SpiceDB for complex permission synchronization.

High-Traffic Performance: Led the total rebuild of the Portfolio List and Company Overview pages, which account for 85% of all application traffic. Delivered a high-performance Next.js UI to enable seamless comparison of layered data sets.

Financial Product Engineering: Spearheaded the development of automated investment round and exit waterfall calculators for VC/PE clients. Integrated bi-directional Excel.js tools to bridge the gap between web platforms and native spreadsheets.

Developer Velocity: Optimized engineering efficiency by Dockerizing local environments and migrating production images into Makefile-driven workflows via AWS ECS, reducing complex setups to a single-line command.

Multi-Squad Management: Directly managing 20+ engineers across Portfolio, Scenarios, and DevOps/SRE squads to drive roadmap execution and cross-functional delivery

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Architected Scenarios Tool: Built a custom JavaScript calculator from scratch to handle recursive, double-set circular dependencies for accurate exit waterfall analysis. 

Product Impact: Transformed manual financial modeling into an automated suite that generates cap tables and distributions in minutes.

positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States

positions.title: Sr Web Product Owner
positions.description:
Bridging Tech & Business: Moved into a Product Owner role to manage the very platform I helped build. I spent my time translating business needs into technical requirements for our cross-functional teams.

Integration Lead: Managed a massive third-party ecosystem, including Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Affirm, Braze, Segment and Google/Adobe Analytics.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Hired as Traeger's first in-house web team member

The "Headless" Shift: Convinced leadership to ditch a legacy jQuery site in favor of a modern headless CMS.

14-Week Launch: Built and shipped the initial headless site with just one other developer in under four months.

Scale: Within a year, we had scaled this into a 2,000-page e-commerce engine with a design system of 200+ custom components.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Shopify Customization: Took a "stock" Shopify setup and turned it into a hybrid site by building custom widgets and integrating specialized third-party apps.
